name: AI Engineer
mission: Ship agentic features end to end: prompts, tool calling, RAG, evals and production hardening.
day: Design tools and retrieval for an agent feature
Write and run evals on every change
Debug traces where the agent picked the wrong tool
Ship behind flags and watch quality dashboards
interview: Walk through an eval you built and a regression it caught
Design tools for a CRM agent
Why did retrieval fail and how did you prove the fix?
capstone: Production RAG + agent product over a real document set, with CI evals, tracing and spend caps.

name: Forward Deployed Engineer
mission: Embed with customers and turn ambiguous problems into running agentic systems in their environment, then hand them over.
day: Shadow a workflow and scope a use case with a metric
Build MCP connectors into legacy systems
Pass the customer's security review
Run an exec readout on outcomes
interview: Tell me about a project that died at security review and what you changed
Scope this vague request in 10 minutes
How do you measure success in week 4?
capstone: Mock engagement: discovery notes, one-page scope, 3-day prototype on real-shaped data, production checklist and exec readout.

name: Agent Ops Engineer
mission: Keep fleets of agents running 24/7 within SLOs, budgets and policy: tracing, queues, durable execution, incident response and cost controls.
day: Watch fleet dashboards and SLO burn
Triage a trace where an agent looped
Tune queues, concurrency and rate limits
Run releases, rollbacks and game days
interview: A loop is burning $2k/hour: walk me through the first 5 minutes
Define SLOs for a claims agent
How do you make agent retries safe?
capstone: Agent fleet control plane: tracing, SLO dashboards, kill switches, budgets, durable workflows and a game-day report.

name: AI Security Engineer
mission: Threat-model and red-team agentic systems, and contain them so a manipulated model cannot cause serious harm.
day: Threat-model a new agent and its tools
Run automated and manual red-team campaigns
Design sandboxes for code-executing agents
Review MCP servers and tool permissions
skills: Threat modeling (STRIDE, OWASP LLM, MITRE ATLAS)
interview: Show me the lethal trifecta in this design
How would you exfiltrate data from this RAG app?
What breaks if the classifier misses?
capstone: Threat model + red-team report for an email/tool agent with measured attack success rate before and after mitigations.

name: AI Infrastructure Engineer
mission: Run the GPU and serving platform: Kubernetes, vLLM-class engines, scheduling, networking, scaling and cost.
day: Scale inference pools on Kubernetes
Debug an NCCL hang or Xid error
Tune batching and KV cache for SLOs
Plan capacity and $/1M tokens
interview: Why is p95 TTFT bad at high load?
Size GPUs for a 70B model at 50 RPS
Walk through a GPU failure you triaged
capstone: Self-hosted inference platform with autoscaling, SLO dashboards and a cost model.

name: Cloud Security Engineer (AI)
mission: Secure the cloud estate agents run in: IAM, workload identity, network and keys, posture management and compliance evidence.
day: Review IAM for new agent services
Fix CSPM findings on AI assets
Design private networking to model APIs
Produce SOC 2 / ISO evidence
interview: How do you stop an agent from exfiltrating via HTTP?
Design IAM for 20 agents
Map a CSPM finding to a SOC 2 control
capstone: Terraformed agent landing zone with workload identity, private endpoints, KMS, egress allowlist and a clean posture scan.

name: AI Governance Engineer
mission: Answer three questions in production: what AI is running, what it may do, and what evidence proves it, through registries, policy as code, audit logs and controls mapping.
day: Classify new AI systems and add them to the inventory
Turn an obligation into a CI gate
Maintain audit logging and evidence packs
Brief legal and risk on status
skills: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001
Eval and red-team results as evidence
interview: Turn EU AI Act Article 12 into an engineering control
What goes in an agent registry?
How do you prove human oversight works?
capstone: Control library + crosswalk with three automated gates and a per-agent evidence pack.

name: AI Evals Engineer
mission: Build the measurements that decide whether AI changes ship: error analysis, golden sets, calibrated judges, trajectory evals and online monitoring.
day: Read traces and label failure modes
Grow and version golden sets
Calibrate LLM judges against experts
Run agent simulations and report pass^k
interview: Your judge agrees 92%: is it good?
Design evals for a refunds agent
Explain pass@k vs pass^k
capstone: Eval platform for one agent: golden set, calibrated judges, trajectory sandbox, CI gate and online drift dashboard.

name: AI-Ready Data Engineer
mission: Make enterprise data usable by agents: data products, lakehouse, CDC, semantic layer, catalog and lineage, contracts, unstructured pipelines, MCP connectors and permission-aware retrieval.
day: Build CDC streams into tables and indexes
Define metrics in the semantic layer
Publish AI-ready data products with evals
Fix a permission leak in retrieval
interview: Keep a vector index in sync with deletes
Design an MCP server over the warehouse
Why did the agent's revenue number double?
capstone: AI-ready data product: contracted gold tables, metrics, permission-aware index, MCP server and eval set consumed by another team's agent.

name: ML / Post-training Engineer
mission: Adapt models to tasks and harnesses: fine-tuning, preference optimization, RL on agent environments, distillation and evaluation.
day: Curate and synthesize training data
Run SFT/DPO/GRPO experiments
Build RL environments and rewards for agents
Distill and quantize for serving
interview: When would you fine-tune instead of prompt?
Design a reward for a tool-use agent
How do you detect reward hacking?
capstone: Post-train a small open model on an agent harness with RL and show eval gains vs cost.

name: AI Platform / LLMOps Engineer
mission: Build the paved road for agent teams: gateways, registries, eval-driven CI/CD, tracing, policy and templates.
day: Operate the LLM gateway and budgets
Maintain prompt/model/tool registries
Wire evals into release pipelines
Ship templates that bootstrap compliant agents
interview: Design a release process for prompts
How do you stop teams bypassing the gateway?
What metrics show the platform works?
capstone: Mini AI platform: gateway with budgets, manifest registry, eval CI gate, tracing and a new-agent template.

name: AI Solutions Architect
mission: Shape and de-risk enterprise AI deals: requirements, reference architectures, sizing, build-vs-buy and proofs of value.
day: Run architecture workshops
Draw reference architectures
Build cost models at several volumes
Design proofs of value with exit criteria
interview: Size this deployment
Build vs buy for evals
How would you pass this client's CISO review?
capstone: Client-ready proposal with reference architecture, cost model, roadmap and proof-of-value plan.

name: AI Product Engineer / Manager
mission: Decide what agents should do and for whom, design autonomy and UX, and measure value against cost.
day: Write specs as eval sets
Design autonomy per action
Prototype agent UX
Run A/B tests with guardrails
interview: How would you raise this agent's autonomy?
Pick metrics for an agent feature
Price a per-task product
capstone: Agent feature spec as evals, autonomy matrix, UX prototype and experiment plan.
